FOOD FOR THOUGHT CHALLENGE — TEAM PREPARATION CHECKLIST
Edition 02 design preview. Rules below are carried forward from Edition 01;
final rules, dates, rewards and registration link await launch confirmation.

YOUR TEAM & FILE
[ ] Form a team of 2–4 participants.
[ ] Prepare a PDF of no more than 5 pages, under 20 MB.
[ ] Use the filename TeamName_CollegeName.pdf.
[ ] Include ideas for BOTH food delivery and dining out.

YOUR CASE
[ ] Map campus population, food habits, cuisine preferences and ordering times.
[ ] Note delivery restrictions and key campus events.
[ ] Identify unmet needs and growth opportunities.
[ ] Present original solutions and explain why they should work.
[ ] Estimate growth, engagement and repeat-use outcomes.
[ ] Set out launch steps, partners, resources, timelines and costs.

FOUR EQUALLY WEIGHTED JUDGING CRITERIA (25% EACH)
Innovativeness / Impact on growth / Execution feasibility / Cost effectiveness

BEFORE YOU FINISH
[ ] Support your case with student research.
[ ] Check your numbers and explain your assumptions.
[ ] Be specific about your campus.
[ ] Include a bold vision and a practical first step.

Questions: swiggyforstudents@swiggy.in
Email subject: Food for Thought Challenge

Original competition: https://www.foodforthoughtchallenge.in/
2025 recap: https://blog.swiggy.com/news/food-for-thought-challenge-2025-swiggys-first-ever-student-case-study-competition/
